title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #4

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which two elements are needed for a crop to grow well? (1 mark)
   A. Water and earth
   B. Space and salt
   C. Fire and metal
   D. Metal and stone

2. In a maize farm, what does the wind that carries pollen represent among the elements? (1 mark)
   A. Jal
   B. Agni
   C. Vayu
   D. Prithvi

3. Who was Hiranyakashipu? (1 mark)
   A. A festival
   B. A river
   C. A proud and cruel king
   D. A good teacher

4. In which city was Guru Ram Das Ji born? (1 mark)
   A. Varanasi
   B. Lahore
   C. Nairobi
   D. Lumbini

5. Which activity helps us remember the teachings of Enlightened Beings? (1 mark)
   A. Reading it silently
   B. Reading the story aloud twice
   C. Acting a skit of a story
   D. Colouring the poster

6. What did Siddhartha do for the wounded swan? (1 mark)
   A. He ignored it
   B. He pulled out the arrow and nursed it
   C. He took it away to eat
   D. He shot it again

7. How would you practise Ahimsa at school? (1 mark)
   A. By breaking things
   B. By hurting insects
   C. By teasing the smaller children
   D. By not bullying and by caring for animals

8. At what time of day did Narsimha appear in the story? (1 mark)
   A. At sunrise
   B. In the evening, between day and night
   C. At noon
   D. At midnight

9. How should we treat a scripture? (1 mark)
   A. With cleanliness and respect
   B. By writing on it
   C. By throwing it
   D. By sitting on it

10. During which Jain festival is the Kalpasutra often read? (1 mark)
   A. Madaraka Day
   B. Paryushan
   C. Maha Shivratri
   D. Vasant Panchami

11. What is the shikhara? (1 mark)
   A. The spire above the inner room
   B. The bell
   C. The floor
   D. The kitchen

12. Which is polite when alighting? (1 mark)
   A. Leave rubbish
   B. Thank the driver or conductor
   C. Push others
   D. Run into the road

13. Who should you give up your seat to? (1 mark)
   A. An elderly person or a pregnant woman
   B. The loudest passenger
   C. Nobody
   D. A friend

14. When getting off a vehicle, what should you do first? (1 mark)
   A. Jump
   B. Stand and push
   C. Wait for it to stop
   D. Run

15. What is a parable? (1 mark)
   A. A kind of prayer
   B. A short story with a lesson
   C. A river
   D. A festival

16. Which organisation set International Yoga Day? (1 mark)
   A. A school
   B. The United Nations
   C. A bank
   D. A local school

17. What does Kapaal Bhaati mean? (1 mark)
   A. Shining forehead
   B. Sitting pose
   C. Moon pose
   D. Diamond pose

18. Which is one of the four Purusharthas? (1 mark)
   A. Moksha
   B. Namaste
   C. Aarti
   D. Bhajan

19. Which principle is being followed by greeting parents with Namaste and saying a morning prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Punarjanam only
   B. Kama only
   C. Prarthana and respect for Paramatma
   D. Artha only

20. Which of the five principles is about goals? (1 mark)
   A. Punarjanam
   B. Prarthana
   C. Purushartha
   D. Paramatma

21. What does atma mean? (1 mark)
   A. Water
   B. Soul
   C. Fire
   D. Body

22. What does Purushartha mean? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A river
   C. The goals of life
   D. A festival

23. What is the abhishek? (1 mark)
   A. Bathing the Shiva Linga with water and milk
   B. Reading a book
   C. Lighting a bonfire
   D. Ringing a bell

24. Which stories are told about Maha Shivratri? (1 mark)
   A. That it is a harvest festival of Kenya
   B. That it is the birth of the Buddha
   C. That it is the night of Shiva and Parvati's wedding or of Shiva's great dance
   D. That it is a Jain festival of forgiveness

25. How should you behave when visiting a friend's festival? (1 mark)
   A. Shout
   B. Refuse to take part
   C. Listen and ask polite questions
   D. Laugh at customs

26. What is a rite or ritual? (1 mark)
   A. A kind of food
   B. A school subject
   C. A special action done in a set way at a festival
   D. A river

27. Maha Shivratri is a festival of which faith? (1 mark)
   A. Sikhism
   B. Hinduism
   C. Buddhism
   D. Jainism

28. Which planet is closest to the Sun? (1 mark)
   A. Saturn
   B. Mars
   C. Mercury
   D. Venus

29. What is the Indian name for Monday? (1 mark)
   A. Budhvaar
   B. Ravivaar
   C. Guruvaar
   D. Somvaar

30. Guru (Brihaspati) is the Indian name for which planet? (1 mark)
   A. Mars
   B. Venus
   C. Jupiter
   D. Saturn

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. What is the essence of a scripture? (2 marks)

32. Explain why forgiveness is important, using Paryushan Parva. (4 marks)

33. Describe the day of prayers for a child. (5 marks)

34. Describe how Paryushan Parva is celebrated. (3 marks)

35. Why is Saraswati shown with a veena and a book? (2 marks)

36. What is Dharma? (2 marks)

37. State three contributions of Sri Guru Ram Das Ji. (3 marks)

38. Suggest four activities for celebrating International Yoga Day in school. (4 marks)

39. List three ideal practices of a passenger while travelling. (3 marks)

40. What do the words Param and atma mean? (2 marks)

41. Write the meaning of Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva. (3 marks)

42. Describe the snake story of Lord Parshvanath. (3 marks)

43. State four ways of caring for plants and water. (4 marks)

44. Who was Sri Guru Ram Das Ji's teacher and predecessor? (2 marks)

45. Name the two Jain scriptures in this lesson. (2 marks)

46. Explain four things a passenger should do when alighting. (4 marks)

47. What is an asana? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #4 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Water and earth
   Soil and water help a crop to grow.

2. C — Vayu
   Wind is air, which is Vayu.

3. C — A proud and cruel king
   He was Prahlad's proud father.

4. B — Lahore
   He was born in Lahore.

5. C — Acting a skit of a story
   A skit helps us learn the lesson.

6. B — He pulled out the arrow and nursed it
   He helped the hurt bird.

7. D — By not bullying and by caring for animals
   Ahimsa means not harming others.

8. B — In the evening, between day and night
   It was neither day nor night but the time between.

9. A — With cleanliness and respect
   Scriptures are kept clean and high.

10. B — Paryushan
   Many Jains listen to it during Paryushan.

11. A — The spire above the inner room
   It is the spire or dome.

12. B — Thank the driver or conductor
   Thanking shows good manners.

13. A — An elderly person or a pregnant woman
   Helping those who need seats shows kindness.

14. C — Wait for it to stop
   Wait until it has stopped.

15. B — A short story with a lesson
   A parable teaches a moral.

16. B — The United Nations
   The UN chose the day in 2014.

17. A — Shining forehead
   Kapaal is forehead and bhaati is shining.

18. A — Moksha
   The four are Dharma, Artha, Kama and Moksha.

19. C — Prarthana and respect for Paramatma
   Prayer and respect for God.

20. C — Purushartha
   Goals of life.

21. B — Soul
   Atma is the soul.

22. C — The goals of life
   Purushartha means the goals of a person's life.

23. A — Bathing the Shiva Linga with water and milk
   Abhishek is ritual bathing of the murti or symbol.

24. C — That it is the night of Shiva and Parvati's wedding or of Shiva's great dance
   Different stories are told.

25. C — Listen and ask polite questions
   Respect is key.

26. C — A special action done in a set way at a festival
   Examples are lighting a lamp or raising a flag.

27. B — Hinduism
   It is a Hindu festival.

28. C — Mercury
   Mercury is nearest to the Sun.

29. D — Somvaar
   Som is the Moon.

30. C — Jupiter
   Guru is Jupiter.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: The most important message or lesson in it.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for a correct meaning.

32. (4 marks)
   Answer: Forgiveness removes anger, mends friendships and brings peace. On the last day Jains ask everyone for forgiveness with Micchami Dukkadam.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four points.

33. (5 marks)
   Answer: In the morning, the Gayatri Mantra and the Saraswati Vandana before study; at midday before meals, Twameva Mata cha Pita Twameva; in the evening, thanks to God. Also sit calmly and fold hands.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part of the day, 1 mark for manners.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jains fast, pray and meditate, listen to scriptures such as the Kalpasutra, practise Ahimsa, give to the needy and ask for forgiveness.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct practice, up to 3.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: The veena stands for music and the arts and the book stands for knowledge.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: The right way of living, including duty, honesty and kindness.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for two ideas.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: He started the city of Amritsar and the Sarovar, composed hymns and the Laavan, and taught equality and service.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each contribution.

38. (4 marks)
   Answer: Doing yoga together, taking photos or videos, making a chart of asanas, making a guidance video with an adult (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wear the seat belt, sit still, keep hands and head inside, keep the aisle clear, do not litter, do not distract the driver, give up your seat (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: Param means highest and atma means soul.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: You are my mother and father. You are my relative and friend. You are my knowledge and wealth. You are everything to me, O God of gods.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each pair of lines, up to 3.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: A man was burning a log. Parshvanath saw that a snake was inside and asked him to stop. The snake was saved, and the man learned a lesson about kindness.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the log, 1 mark for the snake, 1 mark for the rescue or lesson.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: Plant a tree or Tulsi, water plants early or late in the day, collect rainwater, close taps and mend leaks, and never throw plastic into rivers (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct way.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Guru Amar Das Ji, the third Guru.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the name and 1 mark for third Guru.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Kalpasutra and Uttaradhyayan Sutra.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: Wait for the vehicle to stop, take belongings, get off one at a time, look out for traffic, thank the driver (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: A body posture.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for posture or seat.
